gen.title: Numeric ages of the geologic time scale

cards.stem: When numbers are added to the time scale, what age is listed for Earth itself?
cards.quote: Earth is about 4.6 billion years old?
cards.hint: Recall the first benchmark age given for the planet.

cards.stem: What age is given for the rocks that contain the oldest known fossils?
cards.quote: The oldest known fossils are from rocks that were deposited about 3.5 billion years ago?
cards.hint: Think of the age assigned to the earliest fossil deposits.

cards.stem: What age is listed for rocks with the first abundant shelly fossils?
cards.quote: The first abundant shelly fossils occur in rocks that are about 570 million years old?
cards.hint: Focus on the age for the first abundant shelly record.

cards.stem: What timing is given for the end of the last ice age?
cards.quote: The last ice age ended about 10,000 ago?
cards.hint: Recall the most recent age given among the four benchmarks.
